## Job Title
Chefs and Head Cooks

## Job Summary
We seek a dedicated Chef and Head Cook with experience in producing exceptional dining experiences. The ideal candidate would be integral in overseeing the daily food prep as our restaurant is well-regarded for its fine dining. The right candidate will draw upon a passion for quality controls in food preparation as well as a good mastery of inventory operations alongside impeccable menu-planning capabilities.

## Required Skills
* Strong ability in Menu Planning
* Exquisite communication abilities across diverse platforms and populations
* Excellent capability in Inventory Management
* High level of Attention to Detail

## Required Experience
* 1-year experience as Chefs and Head Cooks
* 2 years of experience as Cooks - dealing in a wide variety of meals preparing.

## Responsibilities
* Planning and directing food prep and cooking.
* Monitor safety and sanitation practices. 
* Direct kitchen operations, including dish preparation, cooking, baking etc.
* Planning menus and ensuring uniform serving sizes and top quality in meals.
